Proudly serving

Grand Rapids · Wyoming · Kentwood · Walker · Hudsonville · Rockford · Muskegon · and surrounding West Michigan communities

Questions Grand Rapids families ask us

How fast can you install a wheelchair ramp in Grand Rapids?

For most ramps in our metro service areas, we aim to go from your first call to a finished installation in 48 hours or less. Tell us your discharge or move-in date and we will plan around it.

Should I rent or buy a ramp?

Renting makes sense for short-term needs like recovery from surgery or an injury. Buying is better for permanent mobility needs, and purchased aluminum ramps come with a lifetime warranty. We will recommend the right option during your free visit.

How much does a wheelchair ramp cost?

It depends on the ramp length (set by the height of your steps), rental versus purchase, and the layout of your entrance. We measure for free and give you a clear price with no obligation.

Are your ramps ADA compliant?

Yes. Our professionally installed ramps meet ADA guidelines for safety and accessibility, including handrails and a safe slope.

Do you work with hospitals and case managers?

Yes. We regularly work with case managers, discharge planners and care facilities so the home is ready when your loved one comes home.
